newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Turnover rise on Romania OTC market.
newsitem.headline: Turnover rise on Romania OTC market.

text.p: Turnover on Romania's over-the counter market rose to around 21.5 billion lei against some 16.0 billion last week in lively trading, operators said.
They said a strong buying mood had pushed most prices up.
High-cap cement maker Romcim remained in the limelight of investors' interest, closing 2,200 firmer at 38,500 lei.
Over 13.1 million shares were traded over the week on the RASDAQ -- the Romanian OTC system modeled on the United States Nasdaq -- up from 10.4 million last week.
The independent VAB-RASDAQ index, computed by Vanguard securities, rose 133.5 points on the week to 1,924.9.
The RASDAQ, which opened last October to eventually trade 5,000 companies privatised under a mass selloff, now lists 2,714 stocks. It traded an average 373 companies this week.
